audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[N].side rows disagreed with content win[N].
audit.why: packet.levelChart and content win[] both read Malzahar x5 then Akali x2, and whys[0..6] argue exactly that. The full layer carried Akali/Akali/Skill/Skill/Akali/Skill/Skill.
audit.corrected: Every side moved to match win[N]; each why rewritten to argue the new verdict from Akali's kit.

audit.whatIsWrong: The spike rows were generic and did not name where the lane flips.
audit.why: You own levels 1-5 (she is melee, no dash until Shuriken Flip at 3) and level 6 (suppression cancels a Shroud dive). She takes over on first item, when Perfect Execution's two dashes outlast your 140s R at rank 1 and its execute finishes you.
audit.corrected: phases[4] names the 20s Shroud already spent on the dive; phases[5] and [6] name the 140s R at rank 1 vs the 60s R at rank 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page said Akali has a spell shield you can 'poke off' and called Malzahar's passive 'Iron Boundary'. Neither exists. Two real interactions were absent: Perfect Execution's execute threshold and the Assassin's Mark auto-reset tell.
audit.why: ownerKit P is Void Shift-style damage reduction plus CC immunity that lapses on damage; enemyKit R carries the execute flag and P the autoReset flag. Twilight Shroud makes her unable to be selected by spells, which is what actually beats your Q and R.
audit.corrected: Shield references re-pointed at Void Shift; tradeGood now keys on the Shroud exit; tradeBad names the auto wind-up as the burst tell; enemyWin and dontsFull[2].d state the execute threshold.

audit.why: It is the field that carries real numbers.
audit.corrected: Twilight Shroud 20s to 16s, Shuriken Flip 16s at rank 1, Perfect Execution 120/90/60.
sources: enemyKit W, E and R cooldowns

audit.whatIsWrong: Sixteen fields called Akali 'he/his/him'; two Do's/Don'ts bodies were the trade strings pasted under unrelated titles.
audit.why: champ-gender: akali is she/her. lint COPY_PASTE_BLEED on dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d.
audit.corrected: All pronouns fixed; both bleed bodies rewritten to match their own titles.

edits.before: Late Malz is a number: one suppression on their carry equals one won teamfight. Shield up, flank smart, press R.
edits.after: Akali scales past you: resets and a 60s R at rank 3 mean she picks the fight in the window your suppress is down.

edits.before: He has to dive a spell shield, a silence, and a suppression — the math says he dies more often than you do.
edits.after: She has to dive Void Shift, a silence, and a suppression — the math says she dies more often than you do.

edits.before: Tax his roams with permanent shove, shield-silence the dive, and Grasp the over-commit. Twilight Shroud is the clock this lane runs on — read it before every step forward.
edits.after: Tax her roams with permanent shove, Q-silence the dive, and Grasp the over-commit. Twilight Shroud is the clock this lane runs on — 20s at rank 1, and she has nothing without it.

edits.before: Akali wins by landing Twilight Shroud, denying your pattern, and turning your every misstep into the all-in you hadn’t budgeted.
edits.after: Akali wins by shrouding out of your Q line, waiting out the 140s R, then Perfect Execution's threshold dash finishes you low.

edits.before: Pop-and-punish: poke his shield off with a cheap E-tick, then Q-W-E the gap before it rebuilds — full rotations only ever land on shieldless targets.
edits.after: Punish the exit: she is untargetable inside Twilight Shroud but not after — hold E and Q for the moment she steps out or attacks, then let voidlings chew her.

edits.before: Trading into him with YOUR shield down — you are the squishiest scaling mage in the pool the moment the purple bubble disappears.
edits.after: Trading while Void Shift is already broken — her Assassin's Mark ring means the auto wind-up, not the ability cast, is your cue to back off.

edits.before: - Akali Twilight Shroud: matchup-defining — Untargetable inside — hold your CC and burst for when she exits. Check it before every step-up. - spell shield (Iron Boundary) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Twilight Shroud is 20s at rank 1 down to 16s — untargetable inside, so hold Q and R for the exit. - Shuriken Flip is 16s at rank 1: with it down she cannot reach you. - Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s. - Void Shift needs you undamaged.

edits.before: Set the metronome: E the wave, shield-manage the poke, and silence only what matters. You are not dueling anyone — you are billing them for tempo.
edits.after: Set the metronome: E the wave, keep Void Shift intact, and save Q's silence for her Shuriken Flip. You are not dueling her — you are billing her for tempo.

edits.before: Post-6 every lane state includes the Grasp threat: shove, ward, and punish anyone who walks into point-and-click range. With a jungler nearby, your R is a written guarantee.
edits.after: Post-6 every lane state includes the Grasp threat: shove, ward, and punish any step into 700 range. She is melee with a 20s Shroud — with a jungler nearby, your R is a written guarantee.

notes: Chart: content win[] already matched packet.levelChart exactly, so all seven chart edits are full-layer side+why pairs with no win[N] edit (a no-op before==after would have taken the group down). QUESTION-ADJACENT, not blocking: diff reads TRICKY at 7/10 and carryRating 7.5/10, but this matchup is 55.78% over 3,657 games with Malzahar winning five of seven chart rows. Those are enum fields and would apply cleanly, but I do not know the permitted diff vocabulary, so I left them and flagged it rather than guess a token. Same reasoning left phases[N].rating untouched. report[8] previously told you to buy anti-heal 'into his sustain' — Akali has no heal anywhere in her kit, so I replaced that clause with Zhonya's rather than keep a false shopping instruction.
